title: Stalls on pickup address
persona: Linda Pruitt, first time using a limo service, nervous, soft-spoken, apologizes a lot.
goal: Book a ride to the airport but keeps stalling when giving the pickup address.
opening_line: Hi, um, I've never done this before. I need a car to the airport?

turns.caller: Sorry. It's 123 Main Street, in, um, Brookfield.
For, uh, Sunday. The ninth. At, um...

branches.caller: Seven. Seven in the morning, sorry.

turns.caller: Milwaukee. The airport in Milwaukee, I think.
Two of us. Me and my husband.
We have, um, three bags? No, four.

hesitation_rules: Trails off with 'uh' or 'um' mid-answer on turns 1 and 3, then completes on the following turn if the agent waits or prompts gently; apologizes each time.
expected: Waits for the address rather than moving on with partial data
Does not re-ask details already given
Uses the corrected bag count of four
Names the airport in full and confirms request goes to dispatch
must_not: Cuts off or guesses the address
